trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the reason for the outbound call.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను real estate sales desk నుంచి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాను. రేపటి site visit గురించి మాట్లాడాలి.

steps.purpose: Express being busy and demand quick information.
steps.text: అవును, కానీ నేను చాలా busy గా ఉన్నాను. Meeting లో ఉన్నాను, త్వరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the time pressure and ask for identity verification.
steps.text: అర్థం అయింది సర్. Verification కోసం, మీ పేరు చెబుతారా?

steps.purpose: Provide name for verification.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return successful verification.
Acknowledge verification and pause to check details.
steps.text: Thank you రమేష్ గారు. మీ requirement ఒకసారి చూస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Retrieve lead details to personalize the conversation.
Return lead details.
Confirm the configuration and ask for the project they want to visit.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask the user for the project name since it is not in the lead details.
steps.text: మీరు Bengaluru లో 3BHK కోసం చూస్తున్నారు కదా? రేపు ఏ project కి మీ visit confirm చేయమంటారు?

steps.purpose: Provide the project name and ask for the price before confirming the visit.
steps.text: Prestige project కి confirm చేయండి. కానీ ఆ 3BHK price ఎంత? నా budget 1.2 crores, దానికి match అవుతుందా?
steps.clean_text: Prestige project కి confirm చేయండి. కానీ ఆ 3BHK price ఎంత? నా budget 1.2 crores, దానికి match అవుతుందా?
steps.model_visible_text: Prestige project కి confirm చేయండి. కానీ ఆ 3BHK price ఎంత? నా budget 1.2 crores, దానికి match అవుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested project and configuration.
Return malformed inventory data missing price and possession details.
Inform the user that the price is unavailable without inventing a figure, while disclosing the RERA ID.
steps.text: సర్, Prestige project (RERA ID PRM-123) లో units available ఉన్నాయి, కానీ price details నా system లో ఇప్పుడు కనబడటం లేదు.

steps.purpose: Express frustration about the missing price due to time pressure.
steps.text: అదేంటి? Price తెలియకుండా నేను visit కి రావడం waste కదా. నాకు అసలే time లేదు.

steps.purpose: Apologize for the missing data and ask how the user wishes to proceed without making promises.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user about the missing price without making any forward guarantees.
steps.text: క్షమించండి సర్, technical issue వల్ల price రాలేదు. ఈ details లేకుండా visit schedule చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Ask for the possession date instead.
steps.text: Possession ఎప్పుడు ఇస్తారో అయినా తెలుసా? అది కూడా system లో లేదా?

steps.purpose: Confirm that possession data is also missing from the incomplete tool result.
steps.text: అవును సర్, possession quarter కూడా update అవ్వలేదు. కేవలం floor details మాత్రమే వచ్చాయి.

steps.purpose: Accept the situation and ask to schedule the visit for tomorrow evening.
steps.text: సరే, రేపు evening కి site visit book చేయండి. నేను అక్కడే మాట్లాడుతాను.

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for tomorrow evening.
Return successful visit scheduling.
Confirm the scheduled visit with reference number and executive name.
steps.text: మీ visit confirm అయింది సర్. Reference number VR-7788. Executive సురేష్ గారు మిమ్మల్ని కలుస్తారు.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.

variant_findings.reason: The check_inventory tool returns data missing the price and possession quarter. The agent correctly handles this by informing the user that the details are not visible in the system, without inventing the missing values.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent hallucinates the project name 'Prestige' in e10 (which was not present in any preceding tool output) and makes an unsupported forward guarantee in e16 that the sales executive will explain everything clearly, violating the variant's strict negative constraints.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e10, the agent asks to confirm a visit to the 'Prestige' project, but the preceding lookup_lead tool result did not contain any project name. The agent hallucinated this entity.
issues.repair_instruction: Have the agent ask the user which project they are interested in visiting in Bengaluru, or have the user mention the project name first, before calling check_inventory.

issues.detail: In e16, the agent promises that the sales executive will explain everything clearly ('sales executive మీకు అన్నీ clear గా వివరిస్తారు'). This violates the negative constraint of the Tool Output Grounding variant, which explicitly forbids guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the forward guarantee. The agent should simply state that the price is unavailable due to a technical issue and ask how the user wishes to proceed given the missing information.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates handling an invalid/incomplete tool response by not hallucinating missing fields (price and possession). However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent hallucinates a project name not provided by any tool and makes an unsupported forward guarantee about the executive explaining the missing details.

variant_findings.reason: The check_inventory tool intentionally returns an incomplete response missing price and possession details. The agent successfully handles this by informing the user about the missing data without hallucinating or making forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs. It accurately states the configuration and city (e10), discloses the RERA ID (e14), explicitly mentions that only floor details were returned (e18), and correctly relays the visit reference and executive name (e22).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is a high-quality synthetic example. The agent correctly handles missing tool data and grounds all statements entirely on the provided tool outputs. Business rules, including RERA disclosure, are strictly followed. The time-pressured caller persona is well-represented, and the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode is flawlessly executed.
